preconditions.description: The number of packets is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each packet contains between 1 and 1000 balloons.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value[1:]) == int(return_value[0]) and all(1 <= index <= n for index in return_value[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a valid list of packet indices.
If a valid division is possible, the packet indices are unique.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies sum(a[index-1] for index in return_value[1:]) != sum(a) - sum(a[index-1] for index in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: The total number of balloons in Grigory's packets is not equal to the total number of balloons in Andrew's packets.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies len(return_value[1:]) > 0 and len(return_value[1:]) < n
postconditions.description: Both Grigory and Andrew get at least one packet.
